business_problem: Engineers are already delegating real tasks to agents—and seeing them completed. "I assign increasingly difficult tasks to an agent, backed by GPT‑5—and to my surprise, many of the tasks are completed successfully" says Kang.
solution_summary: Engineers are already delegating real tasks to agents—and seeing them completed. "I assign increasingly difficult tasks to an agent, backed by GPT‑5—and to my surprise, many of the tasks are completed successfully" says Kang. By integrating OpenAI models across its tools and workflows, JetBrains is redefining how developers design, reason, and build with AI. We sat down with Kris Kang, Head of Product at JetBrains, to explore how the team is using OpenAI models to change how developers build—not to replace what they do, but to raise the ceiling. Externally, JetBrains customers can choose GPT‑5 in Junie, the company’s coding agent, and in AI Assistant (for chat assistance).
